# Fixtures

Fixtures must be synthetic or explicitly sanitized. Secrets, personal data, employer sessions, and live Track-A or Track-B content are prohibited.

`stage1/` contains one synthetic approved-facts snapshot, one minimized saved public Greenhouse posting capture, one board-specific offline source policy, and one deterministic fixture command. The full public response body is intentionally not redistributed; its byte count and SHA-256 remain pinned as capture evidence.
